scientific_integrity: Known affine-IFS Fourier product and three mask-zero line families are attributed to their earlier authors; claimed addition is local vanishing-order and two-adic incidence classification with exact lattice densities. No independent validation or publication priority certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Real Fourier zeros for the specified four-digit equal-weight contraction-by-two measure only; lattice junction densities refer to centered integer cubes, not all continuous zeros; a same-object 2012 paper was reviewed at abstract level only, leaving residual priority risk. Finite checker is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
title: Arithmetic triple junctions in the Fourier-zero lines of a dyadic tetrahedral gasket
